# BeanMonitor

> Independent daily market intelligence for the specialty coffee trade.
> We do not sell coffee — we read the market for the people who buy it.

BeanMonitor collects, structures and interprets specialty coffee market data every
morning, then publishes a daily brief written natively in the subscriber's language.

## What we track

- **Prices**: ICE Arabica (Coffee C), cocoa, USD/BRL — each reported with 24h and
  30-day moves and its position in the 52-week range (percentile), not as a bare number.
- **Origin weather**: 9 GPS points across Minas Gerais (Brazil), Huila (Colombia),
  Sidama/Gedeo (Ethiopia) and Dak Lak (Vietnam), compared against 2019-2025 seasonal
  normals rather than raw millimetres.
- **Auctions**: a structured database of Cup of Excellence results — farm, variety,
  process, score, final bid, buyer — across 10 origin programmes, updated daily.
- **Industry press**: 8 publications, ranked by relevance, with importer-published
  analysis explicitly labelled as an interested source.

## Editorial principles

- BeanMonitor sells no coffee, takes no affiliate commission and holds no positions.
- Analysis is AI-written from collected data under standing interpretation rules,
  reviewed by a human editor. Every brief is labelled as AI-generated.
- Market data is indicative and informational. Nothing published is financial advice.

## Access

- Free weekly brief: https://www.beanmonitor.coffee
- Daily brief (Pro): https://www.beanmonitor.coffee#pricing
- API and MCP access: planned with the Team plan
- Contact: hello@beanmonitor.coffee

## Languages

Briefs and site available in English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese and Korean.
Each language edition is generated directly from the data, never machine-translated.
